items.label: Distinguish visible Markdown from tracked hidden Markdown.
items.evidenceTarget: The classification records both the visible rg scan and the tracked git scan so hidden .superpowers/sdd Markdown is not missed.
items.verificationNote: git ls-files '*.md' found 348 tracked Markdown files, while rg --files -g '*.md' found 343 visible Markdown files. The difference is five tracked hidden .superpowers/sdd execution artifacts.

items.label: Classify Core Markdown authority buckets.
items.evidenceTarget: Core Markdown is bucketed as hidden execution artifacts, project-state/planning docs, code-adjacent contracts, historical evidence, generated navigation/version/glossary docs, and repo/package entrypoints.
items.verificationNote: The Project Control classification records location counts, suffix signal counts, Authority/Project Control signal count 4, and 344 tracked Core Markdown files without Authority Boundary or Project Control signal.

items.label: Preserve the Core read-only boundary for this phase.
